title: Release Workflow V1
objective: Harden the tag-only four-platform release workflow for signed macOS, Linux x64/arm64, explicitly unsigned Windows, immutable artifacts, checksums, provenance, and fail-closed publication

handoff.summary: Established independently reviewed four-platform release authority: RC-only Apple credential rehearsal, stable-only protected GitHub publication, exact artifact ID/digest provenance, strict file/checksum policy, signed/notarized macOS, explicit unsigned Windows, and immutable action pins.
risks: The provisional Linux workflow packaging blocks must be replaced by the separately approved glibc-floor baseline-to-SEA candidate invocation before any tag is created.
Real protected macOS signing/notarization and clean-machine Windows archive acceptance remain release-candidate gates.
next_steps: Integrate the approved Linux baseline-to-SEA assembler and extend the publication allowlist to its readiness/report records.
Run v0.2.0-rc.1 through all four platforms and approve sagejs-signing; do not approve or run stable publication for the RC tag.
